QuestInfo.name: [Looks] Celebrity Training
QuestInfo.1: Is monster hunting really going to help her chances? Only one way to find out...
QuestInfo.2: You've been working so hard for your Star... It's all worth it, right?

0.0: I've heard you've been very busy with your fan club, #b#h0##k. That's good, and I'm sure you're doing a good job, but I think there's something you're neglecting. Stars have a very stressful life, and sometimes they need help with the things that cause them stress.
0.1: The stars going for the Maple Rising Star title are no different. In fact, they probably have to train and work harder than others, which leads to even more stress. We really need to help them out. Are you interested?

yes.0: Self-image can cause a lot of unnecessary stress for stars, so I think this is where we can help them most. There's a new exercise trend growing in Maple World. They say that #rhunting monsters#k increases your muscle tone and burns fat at an incredible rate!
yes.1: However, this method has not been scientifically verified, so I cannot suggest it to the stars yet. But that's where you come in,  #b#h0##k. This is a #rCalorie Counter#k. When you hunt monsters, this measures how many calories you burn. I've set it to measure a full workout, so bring it back when the gauge is full. Based on how long it takes you, I can figure out if this is a good exercise method or not.
yes.2: The types of monsters you fight don't matter, but their level does. For you, #b#h0##k, I think you need to #rbattle Level 131 - 150 monsters#k. I think about #b200 monsters#k should do it. Remember, once this gauge is full, bring the counter back to me!

no.0: I guess you just don't understand how stressful this all can be...

item.0: Are you sure you have the right Calorie Counter?

mob.0: Remember, 200 monsters from Levels 131 - 150. Good luck!
